# GP-FIN-GAUSS-MATRIX-ALGEBRA

Fresh H017Fin source proofs cover arbitrary supplied finite Enum Q and Gauss-integer linear endomorphisms: basis recovery, uniqueness, composition and the admitted sesquilinear adjoint. Native 2x2 Gaussian examples retain genuinely imaginary coefficients, all product/action entries, conjugate transpose and both pairings. No conversion from Z[i] to a complex field or spectral theorem is supplied.

Supported: Finite Gauss-integer matrix recovery, uniqueness, composition and adjoint laws are rechecked universally on the source finite enumeration interface; exact native 2x2 examples independently verify the concrete laws.

Remaining: Gaussian coefficients, linearity, finite enumeration and pairing remain assumptions. M_n(Z[i]) supplies neither M_n(C), spectral completeness, CPTP, unique tensor nor continuous time.
